name: winmux
description: A Windows terminal workspace for AI CLI agents

scripts.test:desktop: node tests/desktop-smoke.cjs && node tests/agent-integrations-electron.cjs && node tests/recovery-electron.cjs && node tests/deferred-agent-launch.cjs && node tests/agent-activity-electron.cjs
scripts.test:integrations: node --test tests/client-pressure.cjs tests/environment-discovery.cjs tests/codex-daemon-smoke.cjs tests/codex-mapping.cjs tests/terminal-tab-label.cjs tests/terminal-theme-smoke.cjs tests/agent-hooks-install-smoke.cjs tests/omp-extension-smoke.cjs tests/omp-hooks-install-smoke.cjs tests/agent-activity.cjs tests/agent-integration.cjs tests/agent-processes.cjs tests/codex-activity.cjs tests/agent-adapters.cjs tests/agent-events-ipc.cjs tests/agent-adapter-install.cjs && node scripts/run-electron-node.cjs tests/codex-controller-smoke.cjs && node scripts/run-electron-node.cjs tests/agent-controller-smoke.cjs && node scripts/run-electron-node.cjs tests/title-mode-smoke.cjs
scripts.test:workspace: node --test tests/file-drafts.cjs tests/task-git.cjs tests/task-state.cjs tests/task-delivery.cjs tests/task-instructions.cjs tests/agent-state-since.cjs tests/attention-inbox.cjs && node tests/workspace-smoke.cjs
scripts.test:file-preview: node --test tests/local-file-links.cjs && node tests/file-preview-smoke.cjs && node tests/local-file-preview-electron.cjs
scripts.release:build: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 --publish never
